verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud platform, so it could plausibly offer event webhooks and the axis applies. The pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Fly.io platform events such as deploys, machine state changes or incidents. The only webhook reference (fly-io-docs-32) is about apps hosted on Fly ingesting incoming webhooks, which is a host-platform use case rather than event subscription. The Machines REST API and MCP tooling are adjacent building blocks, not webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
